description: This file defines API routes related to authentication, including user login, registration, profile retrieval, update, and token refresh, using FastAPI framework with dependencies on database, models, and JWT utilities.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying credentials and returning a JWT token with user info.

methods.name: register_user( user_data: UserCreate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles registration of a new user, ensuring unique email and username, hashing password, and returning an auth token.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Returns profile information of the authenticated/trusted user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates profile information of the trusted user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Provides a fresh access token for the trusted user.
